question: ‘Unbreakable’ is an autobiography of an Indian Boxer ___________ and co-authored by Dina Serto.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mary Kom**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Unbreakable is an autobiography by Indian boxer Mary Kom and co-authored by Dina Serto
 
• It was published in the year of 2013.
 
• The book is about Kom's life, including her childhood, struggles, and success in boxing.
 
• It also covers her attempts to study despite household and farm work, which many young Indian girls can relate to. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Laishram Sarita Devi
 
 
• Sport: Boxing
 
• Achievements:
 
• Former world champion in the lightweight category.
 
• Won the gold medal at the 2006 World Championships and several medals at the Asian Games and Asian Championships.
 
• Sarita is known for her aggressive fighting style and resilience in the ring.
 
• Notable Moment:
 
• At the 2014 Asian Games, Sarita protested a controversial decision in her semifinal bout, which became a widely discussed incident in sports ethics.
 
 
 
• Lovlina Borgohain
 
 
• Sport: Boxing
 
• Achievements:
 
• Won a bronze medal in the 2020 Tokyo Olympics in the women’s welterweight category.
 
• Two-time bronze medalist at the World Championships (2018 and 2019).
 
 
 
• Vijender Singh
 
 
• Sport: Boxing (Amateur and Professional)
 
• Achievements:
 
• Won a bronze medal at the 2008 Beijing Olympics, becoming the first Indian boxer to achieve this feat.
 
• Also won medals at the World Championships, Asian Games, and Commonwealth Games.
